writing.exampleCaption: Nothing runs until collect asks for items.
writing.explanation: map and filter build a description of the work; nothing runs until a consumer such as collect, sum, or a for loop asks for items. That laziness is why a long chain still makes a single pass over the data instead of one pass per step.
writing.feedback: map returns a lazy adapter; without a consumer it never runs.
